listing.name: Smoke Free Policy
listing.summary: Mod that establishes a smoke-free policy on the bridge.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces a vanilla portrait to enforce a no-smoking rule on the bridge.

description: Replaces a single vanilla portrait with one depicting a smoke-free environment. The change is purely cosmetic and affects only that specific character image.
